TNFSF molecules are involved in the pathogenesis and development of neuroinflammations and autoimmunity, including experimental autoimmune encepholmyelitis, multiple sclerosis, and neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder.

TNFSF molecules play a critical role in neuroinflammation by regulating the activation and differentiation of immune cells into CNS and also by regulating the survival and proliferation of immune cells.
